claims.campaign_use: youth-AI restriction, data-center restriction, or education-system restructuring
claims.required_discriminator: Compare rhetoric, cited evidence, omitted material facts, professional political intermediaries, funding provenance, and policy asks across fronts before any common-strategy or coordination finding.

classification_rule: A materially false or misleading public claim may be classified as inaccurate or misleading from evidence alone. A dishonesty finding additionally requires evidence that the actor deliberately omitted, misrepresented, or knowingly used facts to create a misleading impression.
next_executable_task: Custody exact primary campaign statements and their cited sources, then populate citation-by-citation support, contradiction, omission, correction, and knowledge-timeline fields.
terminal_condition: Material claims have proposition-level source reconstruction and independent review sufficient to classify support, overstatement, contradiction, and any evidenced deliberateness.
